// Package unmapped references C declarations of types the translation does
// not cover.
package unmapped

/*
#cgo CFLAGS: -DX=1
_Complex float fake_complex(void);
struct bits { unsigned int low : 3; unsigned int high : 5; };
union two { int i; float f; };
#define NOT_A_CONSTANT __attribute__((unused))
*/
import "C"

import _ "syscall" // the generated cgo file imports it

func Complex()   { _ = C.fake_complex() }
func Bits() any  { return C.struct_bits{} }
func Two() any   { return C.union_two{} }
func Macro() any { return C.NOT_A_CONSTANT }
